mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install an accessibility threshold or ramp adjustment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Simple threshold adjustments can sometimes be completed quickly, while more complex ramp work takes longer because it may involve custom measurements, fabrication, permits, or weather delays. In Denver and nearby areas, winter conditions and concrete work can also affect timing.
